paper.$description: Paper — Page background, card surfaces, image holders — the dominant canvas; everything sits on this

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, link text, icon strokes, thin section dividers — the only mark-making color

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, muted metadata, and softer border lines that recede behind primary ink

stone.$description: Stone — Cool-toned border and divider strokes for borders that need a hairline without competing with Ink

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

inter.$description: Body copy, project captions, and the larger intro paragraphs. Used at a single weight — regularity IS the signature; no bold headlines shout, no light weight whispers.

system-ui-sans-serif.$description: Small UI labels, tag text, icon-adjacent microcopy. Appears wherever a single token of body-size type recurs — utility, not statement.

sfnstext.$description: .SFNSText — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
